P1.text: Healthy adults, male or female, aged 18 years old or older,

P2.text: In good general health as evidenced by medical history

P3.text: Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study.

P4.text: Ability of subject to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.

P5.text: Healthy children, male or female, age 7-18,

P6.text: In good general health as evidenced by medical history

P7.text: Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study

P8.text: Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR)) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.

P9.text: Adult and pediatric, male or female, patients with a neuromuscular disorder are eligible even if the exact etiology of the disorder is unknown at the time of enrollment into this study. This will include neuropathy, myopathy and motor neuron disorders. It is expected that the subjects are undergoing appropriate standard diagnostic and genetic work-up outside of this protocol that will later clarify the specific etiology of the disorder. Movement disorder will also be included because of the prior research done on dystonia and EIM.

P13.text: Suspected movement disorders that impair intracortical processes

transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Electrical Impedance Myography: Natural History Studies inNeuromuscular Disorders and Healthy Volunteers". I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 47 years old, so I am definitely 18 or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you currently in good health without any known neuromuscular disorders or other significant medical conditions?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am not in good health. I have cervical cancer that has spread to my liver and lungs, and I have had multiple treatments including surgery, chemo, and radiation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for sharing that. Are you willing to follow all the study procedures and available for the entire duration of the study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have never been evaluated for a neuromuscular disorder. The numbness in my fingers and toes is just a side effect from the chemotherapy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
